builds.description: Preview firmware for Sense360 Ceiling-POE-AirIQ-RoomIQ configuration. Early-access build intended for limited validation of upcoming updates.
features: `Ceiling-POE-AirIQ-RoomIQ`: preview firmware for the Kitchen PoE candidate bundle using Sense360 Core, PoE PSU, AirIQ, and RoomIQ.
`Ceiling-POE-RoomIQ`: preview firmware for the Bedroom PoE candidate bundle using Sense360 Core, PoE PSU, and RoomIQ.
`Ceiling-POE-RoomIQ-LED`: preview firmware for the Living/Corridor PoE candidate bundles using Sense360 Core, PoE PSU, RoomIQ, and LED.
WebFlash-compatible artifact naming for preview firmware import after upstream release assets are generated.
hardware_requirements: `Ceiling-POE-AirIQ-RoomIQ` expects Sense360 Core `S360-100`, AirIQ `S360-210`, RoomIQ `S360-200`, and PoE PSU `S360-410`.
`Ceiling-POE-RoomIQ` expects Sense360 Core `S360-100`, RoomIQ `S360-200`, and PoE PSU `S360-410`.
`Ceiling-POE-RoomIQ-LED` expects Sense360 Core `S360-100`, RoomIQ `S360-200`, LED `S360-300`, and PoE PSU `S360-410`.
These builds are preview firmware only and do not claim hardware verification or compliance certification.
known_issues: Preview firmware is not stable, not recommended, and not a customer default.
Candidate bundles remain hidden from normal shop navigation and are not publicly buyable.
Hardware, bench, compliance, safety, and commercial-availability proof are not claimed for these preview builds.
LED remains preview-only.
FanRelay, FanPWM, FanDAC, and FanTRIAC are not included in this release.
changelog: Added preview firmware artifacts for the Kitchen PoE, Bedroom PoE, and Living/Corridor RoomIQ+LED candidate room-bundle configurations.
Built from the metadata-ready preview WebFlash build rows added after wrapper, compile, and release-note validation.
Preserves the stable Bathroom PoE firmware as the only production/customer-default release.

builds.description: Preview firmware for Sense360 Ceiling-POE-FanPWM configuration. Early-access build intended for limited validation of upcoming updates.
hardware_requirements: `Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-FanRelay-RoomIQ` uses `products/sense360-ceiling-poe-ventiq-fanrelay-roomiq.yaml`; stable blocker remains: Mains-safety / installation-approval / creepage / clearance evidence + competent-person sign-off + GPIO3 strap-pin boot characterisation.

`Ceiling-POE-FanPWM` uses `products/sense360-ceiling-poe-fanpwm.yaml`; stable blocker remains: Measured current / thermal evidence (S360-311-CURRENT-THERMAL-001). RPM / TachIO is not claimed (rpm_supported: false).
`Ceiling-POE-FanDAC` uses `products/sense360-ceiling-poe-fandac.yaml`; stable blocker remains: Cloudlift S12 / J3 harness + product-bench evidence; S360-312 schematic / BOM.
known_issues: PREVIEW firmware only: not stable, not recommended, not a customer default, not hardware verified, and not buyable.
Hardware, bench, mains-safety, and compliance evidence remain stable-only blockers; no such proof is claimed by this release.
`Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-FanTRIAC-RoomIQ` is excluded because `HW-005` still blocks buildability.
These artifacts are not WebFlash one-click imports and are not added to `config/webflash-builds.json`.
changelog: Publish manual-preview firmware for `Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-FanRelay-RoomIQ` as `Sense360-Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-FanRelay-RoomIQ-v1.0.0-preview.bin`.
Publish manual-preview firmware for `Ceiling-POE-FanPWM` as `Sense360-Ceiling-POE-FanPWM-v1.0.0-preview.bin`.
Publish manual-preview firmware for `Ceiling-POE-FanDAC` as `Sense360-Ceiling-POE-FanDAC-v1.0.0-preview.bin`.

builds.description: Stable firmware for Sense360 Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ configuration. Recommended for production deployments.
hardware_requirements: Sense360 Core, SKU `S360-100`, Rev `R4`.
Sense360 PoE PSU, SKU `S360-410`, Rev `R4`.
Sense360 VentIQ, SKU `S360-211`, Rev `R4`.
Sense360 RoomIQ, SKU `S360-200`, Rev `R4`.
No Sense360 TRIAC module for this Release-One firmware.
No Sense360 LED module for this Release-One firmware.
known_issues: Sense360 TRIAC / FanTRIAC is not included in this Release-One firmware.
Sense360 TRIAC remains blocked until S360-320 schematic and direct GPIO/timing requirements are verified.
VentIQ schematic verification is still pending; this build uses the current package-level VentIQ configuration.
changelog: Production Release-One firmware for `Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ`.
Builds the no-TRIAC Release-One configuration while Sense360 TRIAC remains blocked pending hardware verification.
Excludes Sense360 LED because the WebFlash config string does not include `LED`.

builds.description: Preview firmware for Sense360 Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ-LED configuration. Early-access build intended for limited validation of upcoming updates.
hardware_requirements: Sense360 Core R4 or newer
Sense360 PoE PSU
Sense360 VentIQ module
Sense360 RoomIQ module
Sense360 LED ring (S360-300)
known_issues: FanTRIAC is not included in this firmware and remains blocked pending HW-005.
This is a preview release. Do not treat it as the stable Release-One firmware.
LED bench-verification items remain open, including harness identity, LED count, and final install verification.
changelog: Added the first preview firmware build for `Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ-LED`.
This preview extends the Release-One ceiling PoE VentIQ + RoomIQ configuration with the Sense360 LED ring.
This is a preview-channel build for validation and testing. The stable Release-One firmware remains `Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ`.

builds.description: Known-good recovery firmware that bypasses configuration checks to restore a bricked Sense360 hub.
